notes:
Follow-up to 99 for backup drives that drop out.

- A drive that disconnects during a backup check can no longer leave a transfer stuck at "checking backup"
- A flaky cable can no longer mark a good file as changed on the drive
- Verify backup files says plainly when the drive disconnected mid-check, instead of listing those files as failures
- If this update won't install: download SafeStore.dmg from the beta releases page, quit SafeStore with nothing transferring, then drag the new SafeStore into Applications. Updates work by themselves after that
